value.text: Research and development efforts focus on three interconnected ambitions: reinvent productivity and business processes; build the intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform; create more personal computing.

strategic_priorities.quote:
To achieve our vision, our research and development efforts focus on three interconnected ambitions:
•
Reinvent productivity and business processes.
•
Build the intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform.
•
Create more personal computing.

value.text: Innovating and expanding the portfolio with AI capabilities, infusing generative AI into consumer and commercial offerings to deliver copilot capability for all services across the Microsoft Cloud.

strategic_priorities.quote: Our investment in AI spans the entire company, from Microsoft Teams and Outlook, to Bing and Xbox, and we are infusing generative AI capability into our consumer and commercial offerings to deliver copilot capability for all services across the Microsoft Cloud.

value.text: Making the promise of AI real – and doing it responsibly, guided by principles of fairness, reliability and safety, privacy and security, inclusiveness, transparency, and accountability.

strategic_priorities.quote: We're committed to making the promise of AI real – and doing it responsibly. Our work is guided by a core set of principles: fairness, reliability and safety, privacy and security, inclusiveness, transparency, and accountability.

value.text: Helping customers use the breadth and depth of the Microsoft Cloud to get the most value out of their digital spend while leading the new AI wave across solution areas; goal is to lead the industry in several distinct areas of technology over the long term.

strategic_priorities.quote: We are focused on helping customers use the breadth and depth of the Microsoft Cloud to get the most value out of their digital spend while leading the new AI wave across our solution areas.

value.text: Transforming the workplace to deliver new modern, modular business applications, drive deeper insights, and improve how people communicate, collaborate, learn, work, and interact.

strategic_priorities.quote: Transforming the workplace to deliver new modern, modular business applications, drive deeper insights, and improve how people communicate, collaborate, learn, work, and interact with one another.

value.text: Building and running cloud-based services in ways that utilize ubiquitous computing to unleash new experiences and opportunities.

strategic_priorities.quote: Building and running cloud-based services in ways that utilize ubiquitous computing to unleash new experiences and opportunities for businesses and individuals.

value.text: Applying AI and ambient intelligence to drive insights, revolutionize many types of work, and provide substantive productivity gains.

strategic_priorities.quote: Applying AI and ambient intelligence to drive insights, revolutionize many types of work, and provide substantive productivity gains using natural methods of communication.

value.text: Tackling security from all angles with integrated, end-to-end solutions spanning security, compliance, identity, and management, across all clouds and platforms.

strategic_priorities.quote: Tackling security from all angles with our integrated, end-to-end solutions spanning security, compliance, identity, and management, across all clouds and platforms.

value.text: Inventing new gaming experiences and pushing the boundaries of innovation with console and PC gaming.

strategic_priorities.quote: Inventing new gaming experiences that bring people together around their shared love for games on any devices and pushing the boundaries of innovation with console and PC gaming.

value.text: Using Windows to fuel the cloud business, grow share of the PC market, and drive increased engagement with services.

strategic_priorities.quote: Using Windows to fuel our cloud business, grow our share of the PC market, and drive increased engagement with our services like Microsoft 365 Consumer, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Edge, Bing, Xbox Game Pass, and more.

value.text: Future growth depends on the ability to transcend current product category definitions, business models, and sales motions.

strategic_priorities.quote: Our future growth depends on our ability to transcend current product category definitions, business models, and sales motions.

value.text: Continuing to invest in high performance and sustainable computing, expanding datacenter locations and server capacity to meet the growing demand for AI services.

strategic_priorities.quote: We continue to identify and evaluate opportunities to expand our datacenter locations and increase our server capacity to meet the evolving needs of our customers, particularly given the growing demand for AI services.

value.text: Long-term partnership with OpenAI, including increased investments in specialized supercomputing systems to accelerate OpenAI's research.

strategic_priorities.quote: We have also increased our investments in the development and deployment of specialized supercomputing systems to accelerate OpenAI’s research.

value.text: Announced plans to acquire Activision Blizzard, Inc.

strategic_priorities.quote: In January 2022, we announced plans to acquire Activision Blizzard, Inc., a leader in game development and an interactive entertainment content publisher.

value.text: Commitment to being a carbon negative, water positive, and zero waste company by 2030.

strategic_priorities.quote: In 2020, we committed to being a carbon negative, water positive, and zero waste company by 2030.

value.text: Racial Equity Initiative focused on three multi-year pillars, including a $150 million investment to strengthen inclusion and double the number of Black, African American, Hispanic, and Latinx leaders in the United States by 2025.

strategic_priorities.quote: Increasing representation and strengthening inclusion: building on our momentum by adding a $150 million investment to strengthen inclusion and double the number of Black, African American, Hispanic, and Latinx leaders in the United States by 2025.

value.text: Launched a new AI Skills Initiative in June 2023 to help everyone learn how to harness the power of AI.

strategic_priorities.quote: To address this, in June 2023 we launched a new AI Skills Initiative to help everyone learn how to harness the power of AI.

value.text: Managing costs in a dynamic, competitive environment by holding base salaries of salaried employees at fiscal year 2022 levels.

strategic_priorities.quote: In order to manage our costs in a dynamic, competitive environment, in fiscal year 2023 we announced that base salaries of salaried employees would remain at fiscal year 2022 levels.

value.text: National campaign to help skill and recruit 250,000 people into the cybersecurity workforce by 2025, expanded to 27 additional countries.

strategic_priorities.quote: We also launched a national campaign to help skill and recruit 250,000 people into the cybersecurity workforce by 2025, representing half of the country’s workforce shortage.

value.text: Maintain lead as the top commercial cloud while innovating in consumer categories, from gaming to professional social networks

strategic_priorities.quote:
First, we will maintain our lead as the top commercial
cloud while innovating in consumer categories, from gaming to professional social networks.

value.text: Invest to accelerate our lead in AI by infusing this technology across every layer of the tech stack, because maximum enterprise value gets created during platform shifts

strategic_priorities.quote:
Second, because we
know that maximum enterprise value gets created during platform shifts like this one, we will invest to accelerate our
lead in AI by infusing this technology across every layer of the tech stack.

value.text: Continue to drive operating leverage, aligning our cost structure with our revenue growth

strategic_priorities.quote:
And, finally, we will continue to drive
operating leverage, aligning our cost structure with our revenue growth.

value.text: Constant mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more, and to be the democratizing force for this new generation of technology while mitigating its risks

strategic_priorities.quote:
Amid this transformation, our mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to
achieve more remains constant. As a company, we believe we can be the democratizing force for this new
generation of technology and the opportunity it will help unlock for every country, community, and individual, while
mitigating its risks.

value.text: Build Copilot into all our most used products and experiences, as an everyday AI companion and standalone app

strategic_priorities.quote:
We are building Copilot into all our most used products and
experiences and allowing people to summon its power as a standalone app as well.

value.text: Reimagine every customer solution area and every layer of the tech stack for the AI era

strategic_priorities.quote: Every customer solution area and every layer of our tech stack will be reimagined for the AI era.

value.text: Four enduring commitments: expand opportunity, earn trust, protect fundamental rights, advance sustainability

strategic_priorities.quote:
To do this, we
focus on four enduring commitments that are central to our mission and that take on even
greater importance in this new era.

value.text: Train and certify 10 million people by 2025 with the skills for jobs and livelihoods in an increasingly digital economy

strategic_priorities.quote:
That’s why we aim to train and certify 10 million people by
2025 with the skills for jobs and livelihoods in an increasingly digital economy.

value.text: Bring access to affordable high-speed internet to a quarter of a billion people, including 100 million in Africa, by end of 2025

strategic_priorities.quote:
That’s why we’ve expanded our commitment to bring access to
affordable high-speed internet to a quarter of a billion people around the world, including 100 million people in
Africa, by the end of 2025.

value.text: Gaming ambition: be the first choice for people to play great games whenever, wherever, and however they want

strategic_priorities.quote:
In gaming, we are rapidly executing on our ambition to be the first choice for people to play great games whenever,
wherever, and however they want.

value.text: Culture: embrace a growth mindset and confront fixed mindsets; innovate and collaborate as One Microsoft

strategic_priorities.quote:
We need to innovate and
collaborate as One Microsoft.

segments.quote: We operate our business and report our financial performance using three segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing.

value.name: Intelligent Cloud
value.note: Enterprise Services within this segment includes "Industry Solutions (formerly Microsoft Consulting Services)" — a stated renaming of a business line, not of the segment itself.

segments.quote: Enterprise Services, including Enterprise Support Services, Industry Solutions (formerly Microsoft Consulting Services ), and Nuance professional services.
Our More Personal Computing segment consists of products and services that put customers at the center of the experience with our technology.

value.name: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing

segments.quote: We report our financial performance based on the following segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. The segment amounts included in MD&A are presented on a basis consistent with our internal management reporting. We have recast certain prior period amounts to conform to the way we internally manage and monitor our business.

value.name: Devices
value.note: Surface metric expanded into a broader Devices metric in Q1 FY2023 to incorporate additional revenue streams.

segments.quote: In the first quarter of fiscal year 2023, we made updates to the presentation and method of calculation for certain metrics, most notably expanding our Surface metric into a broader Devices metric to incorporate additional revenue streams, along with other minor changes to align with how we manage our businesses.
Enterprise Services revenue increased $315 million or 4% driven by growth in Enterprise Support Services, offset in part by a decline in Industry Solutions (formerly Microsoft Consulting Services).

value.as_stated: approximately 221,000 people on a full-time basis, 120,000 in the U.S. and 101,000 internationally, as of June 30, 2023

headcount.quote: As of June 30, 2023, we employed approximately 221,000 people on a full-time basis, 120,000 in the U.S. and 101,000 internationally.

value.description: Announced cost-structure alignment decisions resulting in a $1.2 billion Q2 charge including $800 million employee severance, hardware portfolio impairment charges, and lease consolidation costs; workforce reduced by approximately 10,000 jobs through Q3 FY2023 (less than 5% of total employee base).

events.quote: On January 18, 2023, we announced decisions we made to align our cost structure with our revenue and customer demand, prioritize our investments in strategic areas, and consolidate office space. As a result, we recorded a $1.2 billion charge in the second quarter of fiscal year 2023 (“Q2 charge”), which included employee severance expenses of $800 million, impairment charges resulting from changes to our hardware portfolio, and costs related to lease consolidation activities.

value.description: Change in accounting estimate effective FY2023: useful lives of server and network equipment increased from four years to six years, increasing operating income by $3.7 billion and net income by $3.0 billion ($0.40 per share).

events.quote: In July 2022, we completed an assessment of the useful lives of our server and network equipment. Due to investments in software that increased efficiencies in how we operate our server and network equipment, as well as advances in technology, we determined we should increase the estimated useful lives of both server and network equipment from four years to six years.

value.description: Pending acquisition of Activision Blizzard for $95.00 per share, all cash, valued at $68.7 billion; merger agreement jointly extended through October 18, 2023 to resolve remaining regulatory concerns.

events.quote: On January 18, 2022, we entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Activision Blizzard, Inc. (“Activision Blizzard”) for $95.00 per share in an all-cash transaction valued at $68.7 billion, inclusive of Activision Blizzard’s net cash. The acquisition has been approved by Activision Blizzard’s shareholders.

value.description: General and administrative expenses increased in part due to a charge related to a non-public preliminary draft decision provided by the Irish Data Protection Commission.

events.quote: General and administrative expenses increased $1.7 billion or 28% driven by employee severance expenses and a charge related to a non-public preliminary draft decision provided by the Irish Data Protection Commission.

value.description: Share repurchases of 69 million shares for $18.4 billion in FY2023, with $22.3 billion remaining of the $60 billion share repurchase program.

events.quote: During fiscal years 2023 and 2022, we repurchased 69 million shares and 95 million shares of our common stock for $18.4 billion and $28.0 billion, respectively, through our share repurchase programs. All repurchases were made using cash resources. As of June 30, 2023, $22.3 billion remained of our $60 billion share repurchase program.

value.description: Board of Directors declared quarterly dividends of $0.68 per share in FY2023, totaling $20.2 billion, up from $0.62 per share and $18.6 billion in FY2022.

events.quote: During fiscal year 2023 and 2022, our Board of Directors declared quarterly dividends of $0.68 per share and $0.62 per share, totaling $20.2 billion and $18.6 billion, respectively.

value.description: Microsoft held its 2022 Annual Shareholders Meeting on December 13, 2022; 6,407,164,715 of the 7,456,502,484 shares entitled to vote were voted in person or by proxy.

events.quote: On December 13, 2022, Microsoft Corporation (the “Company”) held its 2022 Annual Shareholders Meeting (the “Annual Meeting”). There were 7,456,502,484 shares of common stock entitled to be voted at the Annual Meeting, of which 6,407,164,715 were voted in person or by proxy.

value.description: Shareholders elected all twelve director nominees, approved named executive officer compensation on an advisory basis (88.84% votes for), and ratified Deloitte & Touche LLP as independent registered public accounting firm for fiscal year 2023 (95.37% votes for).

events.quote:
(1) Voted to elect each of the twelve (12) nominees for director.
(2) Approved, on an advisory basis, the compensation of the Company’s named executive officers.
(3) Voted to ratify the appointment of Deloitte & Touche LLP as the Company’s independent registered public accounting firm for fiscal year 2023.

value.description: Six shareholder proposals were all not approved: cost/benefit analysis of diversity and inclusion, report on hiring of persons with arrest or incarceration records, report on investment of retirement funds in companies contributing to climate change, report on government use of Microsoft technology, report on development of products for the military, and report on tax transparency.

events.quote:
(4) Did not approve a shareholder proposal concerning a cost/benefit analysis of diversity and inclusion.
(5) Did not approve a shareholder proposal concerning a report on hiring of persons with arrest or incarceration records.
(6) Did not approve a shareholder proposal concerning a report on investment of retirement funds in companies contributing to climate change

value.why_notable: The overview now centers the company's self-description on AI-powered platforms and tools, a framing shift in how management characterizes what Microsoft creates.

notable_language.quote: We are creating the platforms and tools, powered by artificial intelligence (“AI”), that deliver better, faster, and more effective solutions to support small and large business competitiveness, improve educational and health outcomes, grow public-sector efficiency, and empower human ingenuity.

value.why_notable: An unusually direct admission that the AI/cloud investment cycle raises costs and may compress margins.

notable_language.quote: The investments we are making in cloud and AI infrastructure and devices will continue to increase our operating costs and may decrease our operating margins.

value.why_notable: New, concrete dependency language naming land, energy, and GPUs as constraints on datacenter expansion.

notable_language.quote: Our datacenters depend on the availability of permitted and buildable land, predictable energy, networking supplies, and servers, including graphics processing units (“GPUs”) and other components.

value.why_notable: A forward-looking commitment to rising capex explicitly tied to AI infrastructure.

notable_language.quote: We expect capital expenditures to increase in coming years to support growth in our cloud offerings and our investments in AI infrastructure.

value.why_notable: Management pairs the layoff disclosure with 'divesting in other areas' — an explicit statement of selective retrenchment alongside continued hiring.

notable_language.quote: While we eliminated roles in some areas, we will continue to hire in key strategic areas. Second, we are allocating both our capital and talent to areas of secular growth and long-term competitiveness, while divesting in other areas.

value.why_notable: Direct attribution of the decline to channel inventory on top of underlying PC demand weakness — candid about two compounding negatives.

notable_language.quote: Windows OEM revenue decreased 25% as elevated channel inventory levels continued to drive additional weakness beyond declining PC demand.

value.why_notable: Hedged forward language signaling possible additional real-estate charges in future periods.

notable_language.quote: Third, we are consolidating our leases to create higher density across our workspaces, which impacted our financial results through the remainder of fiscal year 2023, and we may make similar decisions in future periods as we continue to evaluate our real estate needs.

value.why_notable: Hedging phrase 'which remain dynamic' used in place of a plainer statement about macro and geopolitical risk.

notable_language.quote: Aggregate demand for our software, services, and devices is also correlated to global macroeconomic and geopolitical factors, which remain dynamic.

value.why_notable: The committee turns a below-target result into evidence of goal rigor rather than underperformance — a defensive framing of a miss.

notable_language.quote: We note that our Incentive Plan Revenue result was 95.38% of target, which equated to a 10.98% fiscal year 2023 growth rate, further demonstrating our commitment to rigorous goal setting.

value.why_notable: Explicit statement of continuity: no substantial program changes, justified by say-on-pay support (over 88%).

notable_language.quote: In evaluating our compensation practices in fiscal 2023, our Compensation Committee was mindful of the support our shareholders expressed for our philosophy and practice of linking executive compensation to operational objectives and shareholder value creation, and did not make any substantial changes to our executive compensation program.

value.why_notable: A stated change in benchmarking methodology — splitting into Primary Technology and Secondary General Industry peer groups — with the committee's own rationale.

notable_language.quote: For fiscal year 2023, the Compensation Committee reviewed the evolution of our business against our historical peer group, and as a result approved the use of two peer groups to better reflect the differentiated business, talent and, in some cases, pay models, across sectors:

value.why_notable: The single individualized pay increase of the year, with the stated reason being competitive market review rather than performance.

notable_language.quote: We did not increase our target award values for our Named Executives, except in the case of Mr. Althoff whose target award value increased from $12,600,000 to $14,640,000 based on a competitive market review.

value.why_notable: Recurring justification for holding CEO salary flat; the appeal to 'relative scale and performance' is the committee's standing formula.

notable_language.quote: The independent members of our Board did not increase the base salary of Mr. Nadella, which it continued to believe was reasonable and appropriate given his role, capabilities, and experience, as well as the Company’s relative scale and performance.

value.why_notable: Market-pressure framing used to pre-justify pay levels; language worth tracking year over year as labor conditions change.

notable_language.quote: The current technology labor market is hyper-competitive with demand growing faster than the supply of specialized technical talent, resulting in significant increases in compensation at many of the companies with which we compete for this talent.

value.why_notable: Defense of annually reset goals inside a three-year LTI period — a design shareholders often criticize as short-term; the committee addresses it directly.

notable_language.quote: Due to the dynamic nature of our business and the specificity of the performance metrics that are chosen under our PSA program, we believe that measuring performance annually over our three-year performance period and modifying the actual awards eligible to be earned based on our three-year relative TSR provides the most accurate and holistic assessment of Microsoft’s long-term trajectory and performance achievements.

value.why_notable: Explicit note that the CEO receives no time-based equity, positioning 100% of his equity as performance-based.

notable_language.quote: After considering the recommendation of our Compensation Committee, the independent members of our Board approved Mr. Nadella’s base salary, target cash incentive, and target performance stock award, providing no time-based stock awards for fiscal year 2023.

value.why_notable: Layoffs surface in the CEO's operational assessment as a leadership credit rather than a negative — the category still paid 110%.

notable_language.quote: While Microsoft was not immune to the workforce reductions experienced by many technology organizations, Mr. Nadella’s leadership encouraged a focus on dignity and respect for impacted employees throughout the process.

value.why_notable: Discloses that incentive targets equal the internal operating budget — the mechanism linking pay to management's own plan.

notable_language.quote: Our Compensation Committee sets cash incentive and performance stock award (“PSA”) metric targets at the levels established, after review and engagement by the Board, for internal budgeting purposes. These targets are intended to be challenging but achievable.

value.why_notable: Opening frame pairs acknowledged macro volatility with an unhedged claim that AI will transform every industry — sets the letter's dominant register.

notable_language.quote:
We are living through a time of historic challenge and opportunity. As I write this, the world faces ongoing economic,
social, and geopolitical volatility. At the same time, we have entered a new age of AI that will fundamentally
transform productivity for every individual, organization, and industry on earth

value.why_notable: Historical-legitimacy argument: positions AI not as a new bet but as the latest in a series of survived platform shifts, and claims leadership of the era outright.

notable_language.quote:
Forty-eight
years after its founding, Microsoft remains a consequential company because time and time again—from PC/Server,
to Web/Internet, to Cloud/Mobile—we have adapted to technological paradigm shifts. Today, we are doing so once
again, as we lead this new era.

value.why_notable: The only financial claim in the letter, framed as 'record' and tied directly to the three priorities.

notable_language.quote:
As we make progress on these priorities, we delivered strong results in fiscal year 2023,
$211 billion in revenue and over $88 billion in operating income.

value.why_notable: Unusually direct acknowledgment that the disruption applies to Microsoft itself, not only to customers.

notable_language.quote: This next generation of AI will reshape every software category and every business, including our own.

value.why_notable: Responsibility framing placed immediately after the Copilot vision — safety language recurs throughout the letter.

notable_language.quote:
We believe AI should be as
empowering across communities as it is powerful, and we’re committed to ensuring it is responsibly built and
designed, with safety in mind from the outset.

value.why_notable: Rare plain admission of AI-driven job displacement, immediately balanced by an offsetting claim.

notable_language.quote: AI will displace some jobs, but it will also create new ones.

value.why_notable: Pre-emptive defense of AI credibility by dating the practice to 2017 — a recurring 'not new' construction.

notable_language.quote:
Our commitment to responsible AI is not new. Since 2017, we’ve worked to develop our responsible AI practice,
recognizing that trust is never given but earned through action.

value.why_notable: Concedes the limits of self-governance and pivots to advocating external regulation — notable for a company on AI policy.

notable_language.quote:
We have translated our AI principles into a core set of implementation processes, as well as tools, training, and
practices to support compliance. But internal programs aren’t enough.

value.why_notable: An unusually candid sustainability disclosure: a very small emissions decline plus a named unresolved problem ('ultimate challenge').

notable_language.quote:
In 2022, our overall carbon emissions declined by 0.5 percent while our
business grew. Addressing scope 3 emissions, which account for the vast majority of our emissions, is arguably our
ultimate challenge—one we’ll continue to tackle

value.why_notable: Culture section signals rising internal performance pressure and coming changes to business models and sales motions.

notable_language.quote:
In an economy where yesterday’s exceptional is today’s expected, all of us at Microsoft will need to embrace a
growth mindset and, more importantly, confront our fixed mindsets as our culture evolves. It will take everyday
courage to reformulate what innovation, business models, and sales motions look like in this new era.

value.why_notable: Oblique reference to 'challenges' (layoffs/cost discipline are never named directly) attached to a diversity claim.

notable_language.quote: Even as we navigated challenges this year, our company continued to be the most globally diverse it’s ever been.

value.why_notable: Peak rhetorical claim of the letter — 'this is Microsoft's moment' — repeated in the following paragraph as 'our moment to show up'.

notable_language.quote:
In closing, this is Microsoft’s moment. We have an incredible opportunity to use this new era of AI to deliver
meaningful benefits for every person and every organization on the planet.

value.why_notable: Closing confidence statement subordinates shareholder outcome to societal outcome; 'never been more confident' is a superlative worth tracking year over year.

notable_language.quote:
If we do it well, the world will do well, and Microsoft will do
well too. I’ve never been more confident that we will deliver on this promise together

more in the coming months about how, together, we will bring the joy of gaming to more people around the world.

Although it’s early in our journey, Bing users engaged in more than 1 billion chats and created more than 750 million
images over the past year

segments_basis.basis: reportable segments as named by the filing

investor_qa_basis.basis: management's written answers to questions submitted by investors, published roughly monthly. Same verification as every other fact — whole-document boundaries and a checked quote — but a different kind of evidence from a 10-K or proxy statement: unaudited, unprompted by any disclosure requirement, and responsive to whatever was asked. Corroborating; not a substitute for a filed disclosure.

ids.basis: content hash of the claim, its evidence and its source — see `fact_id` in src/equity_research/ledger_schema.py. Confidence and the verification result are NOT hashed, so re-verifying a fact does not renumber it. Cross-year uniqueness is enforced fatally at build time by `audit_ids`.

document_window.basis: filing dates of the documents this year's facts are actually drawn from — NOT the fiscal window in inventory.json, which bounds the fiscal years in scope. Documents reporting on a fiscal year are filed after it ends, so this range extends past window_end_date by construction. Any accession listed above additionally belongs to a fiscal year outside the window and is used deliberately: an annual-meeting vote held in May of year N decides on year N-1.

corrections.basis: config/corrections.toml — human corrections to model-extracted values that the cited filing contradicts, each carrying the filing text that establishes it. data/ledger/facts/ is never edited: the record of what the model returned has to stay as it was.
